Ability to work with deadlines and complete tasks on time. Driven and result oriented. Passionate about the work · Ability to work independently or as part of a team · Ability to complete tasks effectively with minimal supervision · Must be available to work flexible work schedules

Job Title: RN – Modified Care Unit Location: Menomonee Falls, WI, 53051 Duration: 10/27/2025 – 01/23/2026 Shift: 3rd Shift (19:00 – 07:30) Schedule: 3x12 hrs/week, 36 hrs/week; 12 hr nights; every other weekend; float as needed; no on-call Required Skills & Experience Cardiac Telemetry Care experience. Experience with diverse patient population including MI, CHF, COPD, strokes, stable arrhythmias, and patients needing closer cardiac monitoring and assessment. Professional knowledge of nursing theory and practice at a level normally acquired through completion of a minimum of two years education at an accredited School of Nursing in order to be eligible for licensure as a Registered Nurse. Education Associate’s degree in nursing – Required. Bachelor’s degree in nursing – Preferred. Licensure & Certifications Current state of Wisconsin Registered Nurse License or Multi-state Nursing License from a participating NLC state. American Heart Association (AHA) Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Provider or AHA approved equivalent – Required. AHA HeartCode Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) for healthcare providers or AHA approved equivalent – Required. Job Summary Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate nursing care for an identified group of patients in an inpatient environment. Deliver competent nursing care to a primarily adult population. Perform functions adapted from ANA Nursing: Scope and Standards of Practice, 2nd Edition (2010).

Location: Chicago, IL Introduction We are seeking a skilled professional to design, implement, and support Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. This role is crucial in securing digital identities, enabling seamless user access, and maintaining compliance across enterprise systems. Required Skills & Qualifications Must-have qualifications that candidates must meet to be considered: Applicants must be able to work directly for on W2 5 years of experience with Ping Identity / ForgeRock (AM, IDM, DS, IG) Strong Java application, Groovy, REST APIs, OAuth2/SAML experience Knowledge of Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and CI/CD processes Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Preferred Skills & Qualifications Nice-to-have skills but are not required: Background in financial services Familiarity with automation tools like Terraform/Ansible and monitoring tools Day-to-Day Responsibilities Key tasks and expectations for the role: Design, implement, and support IAM solutions using Ping Identity and ForgeRock Integrate with enterprise applications, enable SSO/MFA, and support compliance efforts Develop APIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system availability Company Benefits & Culture Collaborative and inclusive work environment Opportunities for professional growth and development Commitment to diversity and equal opportunity For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.
